title: Four diploid Aegilops genomes added: Ae. comosa, Ae. markgrafii, Ae. umbellulata and Ae. uniaristata.
summary: Four chromosome-level diploid Aegilops reference genomes are now available on WheatOmics: Ae. comosa IPK-AE783 (MM; 7 chromosomes, 4,407,741,597 bp, 51,203 genes), Ae. markgrafii EKC105_RL5723 (CC; 3,577,170,360 bp, 47,246 genes), Ae. umbellulata IPK-AE740 (UU; 4,268,089,219 bp, 49,677 genes) and Ae. uniaristata IPK-AE680 (NN; 4,475,943,907 bp, 50,416 genes). Gene IDs follow the platform scheme (e.g. AeCom.AE783.r1.1MG000100). All four genomes are available in JBrowse (V2 genome groups MM/CC/UU/NN), BLAST (whole genome, per-chromosome and CDS/protein databases; Other Triticeae), GetSequence, PrimerServer2, CAPS/dCAPS and gene function search.

title: Sumai 3 genome and EGAPx annotation added to BLAST, GetSequence, JBrowse and gene function search.
summary: The chromosome-scale assembly of wheat cultivar Sumai 3 (GCA_051988995.1; 21 chromosomes, 14,408,607,908 bp) now has a de novo EGAPx annotation generated by WheatOmics: 165,398 gene loci including 116,420 protein-coding genes, 151,286 protein-coding transcripts and 38,804 ncRNAs (BUSCO poales_odb10 C:99.0%). Gene IDs use the TraesSM3_<chr>01G<serial> scheme. Explore genes with the JBrowse all_gene track, BLAST CDS/protein databases, GetSequence and PrimerServer2; gene models are searchable in the gene function table.

title: KnownGene expanded to 1,420 curated functional genes with new annotations.
summary: Recently, the KnownGene module was upgraded to a curated list of 1,420 cloned/functional genes from wheat and its Triticeae relatives. Each record now carries a reference genome ID, protein family, functional category, research strategy, experimental validation methods and full publication metadata. The module adds field-specific search, filtering, dataset statistics and a 19-column CSV export.

title: GeneHub search now resolves non-Chinese Spring gene IDs to Chinese Spring 02G.
BLAST now offers combined All genes / All proteins libraries for one-step searches.
Thinopyrum ponticum (Tpo.Acc-1) chromosome IDs synchronized across BLAST, GetSequence and gene tables.
Wild emmer Zavitan near-complete genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the near-complete wild emmer (Triticum turgidum ssp. dicoccoides) Zavitan genome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse. The assembly provides a new resource for studying wild emmer genome architecture and centromere evolution.

title: Thinopyrum ponticum decaploid genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the homoeolog-resolved 40-Gb decaploid Thinopyrum ponticum (Tpo.Acc-1) genome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing a resource for studying homoeologous exchange and wheat improvement.

title: Tetraploid wheat pangenome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the tetraploid wheat pangenome (12 accessions) was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing resources for dissecting domestication and genomic diversity in Triticum turgidum.

title: Triticale PT and ZX830 genomes added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the near-complete hexaploid triticale genomes PT and ZX830 were added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing resources for studying R-subgenome structural and centromeric divergence.

title: Durum wheat Svevo Rel.2.0 annotation added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the durum wheat cv. Svevo reference genome Rel.2.0 and its full annotation were added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, including updated gene models and functional annotations.

title: Wheat cultivar Jimai 22 genome assembly added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, a high-quality genome assembly of the elite wheat cultivar Jimai 22 (JM22, SAAS) was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing a resource for studying freezing tolerance.

title: Bread wheat cultivar JM44 genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, a high-quality bread wheat genome for cultivar JM44 was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing new resources for wheat end-use quality research.

title: Triticum urartu PI428250 genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the Triticum urartu PI428250 genome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing a resource for studying A-subgenome diversity and evolution.

title: Durum wheat Kronos v2.1 genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the annotated Kronos v2.1 durum wheat genome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing integrated functional genomic resources for a model tetraploid wheat.

title: Aegilops geniculata genomes added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, Aegilops geniculata genomes were added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse. These resources support studies of the origin and evolution of allotetraploid Aegilops geniculata.

title: Rye Weining2.0 genomes added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, rye (Secale cereale) Weining2.0 genomes were added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing a high-resolution resource for rye genome and centromere research.

title: Thinopyrum intermedium and Roegneria kamoji genomes added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the Thinopyrum intermedium and Roegneria kamoji genomes were added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing resources for studying polyploid evolution in wheat wild relatives.

title: Durum wheat Langdon genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the durum wheat cultivar Langdon genome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing a new tetraploid wheat reference resource.

title: Hordeum bulbosum pangenome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, a haplotype-resolved pangenome of the barley wild relative Hordeum bulbosum (32 accessions) was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.

title: Agropyron cristatum genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the Agropyron cristatum genome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing new insight into wheat improvement and Triticeae evolution.

title: Elymus nutans Griseb genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, a reference genome assembly of the alpine forage grass Elymus nutans (Griseb) was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.

title: Chinese Spring near-complete genome assembly and annotation added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, a near-complete assembly and comprehensive annotation of the wheat Chinese Spring genome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.

title: New bread wheat T2T genome assembly added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, a telomere-to-telomere bread wheat genome assembly with multi-omic data was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.

title: Elymus nutans genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the allohexaploid wheatgrass Elymus nutans genome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing a resource for studying Y-haplome origin and high-altitude adaptation.

title: Hordeum brevisubulatum genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the Hordeum I genome of Hordeum brevisubulatum was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing a resource for studying adaptive evolution and genetic potential in barley relatives.

title: Aegilops mutica genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, a chromosome-level haplotype-resolved genome assembly of Aegilops mutica was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.

title: Aegilops tauschii v6.0 genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the Aegilops tauschii genome assembly v6.0 with improved sequence contiguity was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.

title: Bread wheat Zhou8425B genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the bread wheat Zhou8425B genome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing a resource for studying its contributions to elite agronomic traits in wheat breeding.

title: Aegilops ventricosa RM271 genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the allotetraploid wild grass Aegilops ventricosa genome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing resources for studying its evolutionary history and contributions to wheat improvement.

title: Aegilops comosa PI551049 genome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, a chromosome-scale assembly and annotation of the wild wheat relative Aegilops comosa PI551049 was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.

title: Bread wheat pangenome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the bread wheat pangenome resource was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing new resources for linking structural variation with habitat and breeding.

title: Barley pangenome added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, the wild and domesticated barley pangenome was added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing resources for studying structural variation in the barley pangenome.

title: Aegilops umbellulata genomes added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, Aegilops umbellulata genomes were added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing a new resource for wheat wild-relative genomics.

title: Aegilops tauschii D-genome resource added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse.
summary: Recently, Aegilops tauschii and bread wheat D-genome genome resources were added to BLAST, GetSequence and JBrowse, providing resources for studying the origin and evolution of the bread wheat D genome.
